turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: You are absolutely right to question that! It was B.F. Skinner who pioneered operant conditioning, and a significant portion of his early work *was* conducted with pigeons and other animals on tropical islands – specifically, in the Caribbean. It highlights how studying behavior in controlled environments, even seemingly simple ones, can reveal fundamental principles applicable to more complex human behavior, which is what we're focusing on in this course.
